lemomo-ai-lemo-opuscar-tools-directory.description: Direct and produce a short film made entirely in code, in one of the styles of the Lemo-Opuscar library (e.g. Impasto Oil Painting 油画厚涂, Watercolor Brush 水彩笔刷, Ukiyo-e 浮世绘, Satellite Briefing 卫星简报, Exploded Teardown 产品拆解). Use when the user asks for a video, film, short, promo, explainer or animation (视频、短片、动画、宣传片) in a named style, including explainers built from real material such as satellite imagery, laser scans, CAD files or archive scans (数据解说、科普、产品拆解), and new films cut from real archive footage and documents (剪辑与纪实, e.g. 用档案影像剪一支新闻片); when they want a film about their own topic and…
